title: Overview
description: An introduction to ExcelJS, outlining its purpose, key features, and overall architecture to help you quickly understand its capabilities.

title: Quick Start
description: A fast-paced guide designed for developers to install ExcelJS, create a simple spreadsheet, and save it, all within minutes.

title: Core Concepts
description: An explanation of the fundamental architecture, data models, and operational modes of ExcelJS for developers and technical decision-makers.

title: Guides
description: A collection of practical, in-depth guides covering the primary features and functionalities of the ExcelJS library.

title: API Reference
description: A detailed reference of all public classes, methods, and properties available in the ExcelJS library.

title: Migration Guides
description: Instructions for updating your code to accommodate breaking changes in new versions of ExcelJS.

title: Installation
description: Step-by-step instructions for installing the ExcelJS library in your project environment.

title: Creating Your First Spreadsheet
description: A complete, copy-paste example to guide you through creating a workbook, adding data, and saving your first spreadsheet file.

title: Object Model
description: An overview of the core object hierarchy, including Workbooks, Worksheets, Rows, and Cells, which forms the basis of all document interactions.

title: Document vs. Streaming I/O
description: A comparison of the two primary modes of operation, detailing the trade-offs between memory usage and feature availability for architects and developers.

title: Value Types
description: A guide to the different types of data a cell can hold, such as numbers, strings, dates, formulas, and rich text.

title: Reading & Writing Files
description: Learn how to read and write spreadsheet files in both XLSX and CSV formats using the document-based model.

title: Streaming Data
description: A guide to using the memory-efficient streaming APIs for reading and writing large spreadsheet files.

title: Workbooks
description: Instructions for configuring workbook-level properties such as creator information, date systems, and window views.

title: Worksheets
description: A guide to managing worksheets, including properties, views, page setup, and protection.

title: Rows & Columns
description: Learn how to manipulate rows and columns, including adding, accessing, splicing, and setting outline levels.

title: Cells
description: A comprehensive guide to working with cells, covering value types, merging, defined names, data validation, and comments.

title: Styling
description: Instructions on how to apply various styles to cells, rows, and columns, including fonts, alignment, borders, fills, and number formats.

title: Advanced Features
description: Explore advanced functionalities like embedding images, creating tables, pivot tables, and applying conditional formatting.

title: Upgrading to v4.0
description: Key changes and steps required to migrate your project from ExcelJS v3.x to v4.0, focusing on the new streaming reader API.
